history.title: Bombay · Governor General Tax
history.report:
Resolve the successful Tax’s £2 payment on the table; do not place it in the Governor General’s own treasury.

Add 1 unrest to Bombay (now 1).

lines.text: The Company had expected gratitude, or at least obedience. The inhabitants, demonstrating their usual difficulty with administrative terminology, appeared to have confused both with resentment.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: “The Company has presented its demands. I shall reserve my gratitude until I discover what remains afterward.”
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: “The revenue has been requested. I am confident the gentlemen responsible for providing it will appreciate the distinction between a request and an obligation.”
lines.speaker: Arthur Pembroke

history.title: Governor General · Govern check
history.report:
Add 1 unrest to Bengal (now 1).

Add 1 unrest to Bombay (now 2).

Add 1 unrest to Madras (now 1).

Resolve any office consequences on the table. The failed-check unrest includes all reported sixes.

lines.text: Bengal: Governor General failure recorded; 1 unrest added. Bombay: Governor General failure recorded; 1 unrest added. Madras: Governor General failure recorded; 1 unrest added.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: The administration in Bengal has produced another matter for the court to consider.
lines.speaker: Azim of Bengal

lines.text: “A discontented population is a dangerous thing. Particularly when those responsible for its discontent believe themselves universally adored.”
lines.speaker: Mansur of Madras

lines.text: “Anger is easily gathered. It is rather more difficult to persuade it to march in the same direction.”
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: “There appears to have been a failure somewhere between the issuing of instructions and their unfortunate execution.”
lines.speaker: Arthur Pembroke

history.title: Manual event test · Turmoil
history.report:
Close Hyderabad £7 (only order). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Manual test: the digital event stack and phase event count are unchanged. Use Undo to reverse this test’s board effects.

lines.text: Hyderabad: a commercial opportunity was disrupted.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: “The Company appears astonished that trade requires the cooperation of those with whom it wishes to trade.”
lines.speaker: Yusuf of Hyderabad
